name: Lentils (Black)
siboNotes: Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) as galactans can feed bacterial overgrowth. Consider enzyme supplements containing alpha-galactosidase.
preparationTips: Rinse canned lentils thoroughly to reduce FODMAP content
Start with small portions and gradually increase tolerance
Cook dried lentils thoroughly and discard cooking water
Combine with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano or thyme for flavor
alternatives: Eggs or chicken for complete protein
nutritionalHighlights: High in plant-based protein (9g per 1/2 cup)
